note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: Which country does Airline "JetBlue Airways" belong to?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM AIRLINES WHERE Airline  =  "JetBlue Airways"

questions.question: What is the abbreviation of Airline "JetBlue Airways"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Abbreviation FROM AIRLINES WHERE Airline  =  "JetBlue Airways"

questions.question: What are the airline names and abbreviations for airlines in the USA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Airline ,  Abbreviation FROM AIRLINES WHERE Country  =  "USA"

questions.question: How many airlines do we have?
Which airline has abbreviation 'UAL'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Airline FROM AIRLINES WHERE Abbreviation  =  "UAL"

questions.question: Return the number of United Airlines flights leaving from AHD Airport.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T2.Airline  =  T1.uid WHERE T1.Airline  =  "United Airlines" AND T2.SourceAirport  =  "AHD"

questions.question: Count the number of United Airlines flights that arrive in Aberdeen.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN AIRLINES AS T3 ON T3.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen" AND T3.Airline  =  "United Airlines"

questions.question: Which city has the most frequent destination airport?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.City FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.DestAirport GROUP BY T1.City ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the code of airport that has the highest number of flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.AirportCode FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.DestAirport OR T1.AirportCode  =  T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.AirportCode ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the airport code of the airport with the most flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.AirportCode FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.DestAirport OR T1.AirportCode  =  T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.AirportCode ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Give the code of the airport with the least flights.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.AirportCode FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.DestAirport OR T1.AirportCode  =  T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.AirportCode ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which airline has most number of flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline GROUP BY T1.Airline ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which airlines have departures from CVO but not from APG airports?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.SourceAirport  =  "CVO" EXCEPT SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.SourceAirport  =  "APG"

questions.question: Which airlines have at least 10 flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline GROUP BY T1.Airline HAVING count(*)  >  10

questions.question: Which airlines have less than 200 flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline GROUP BY T1.Airline HAVING count(*)  <  200

questions.question: What are flight numbers of Airline "United Airlines"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.FlightNo FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRLINES AS T2 ON T2.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.Airline  =  "United Airlines"

questions.question: Which flight numbers correspond to United Airlines flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.FlightNo FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRLINES AS T2 ON T2.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.Airline  =  "United Airlines"

questions.question: Find the number of flights landing in the city of Aberdeen or Abilene.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Flights AS T1 JOIN Airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.city  =  "Aberdeen" OR T2.city  =  "Abilene"

questions.question: How many flights land in Aberdeen or Abilene?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Flights AS T1 JOIN Airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.city  =  "Aberdeen" OR T2.city  =  "Abilene"
